svg.title: Nonna versus a bare agent
svg.desc: Mistakes on five trap tasks: bare agent 5 in 20 runs, Nonna 0 in 22. Changes that left a test: 0 of 12 versus 12 of 12. Cost per change: $0.13 versus $1.96. Nonna pays for herself when one cleanup costs more than $7 at 1 mistake in 4 changes, $37 at 1 in 20, $183 at 1 in 100.
